messages.content: I need flights for a Denver client workshop. It runs Wednesday through Friday, ending at 2:00 Friday. I can leave Minneapolis Tuesday after 4:30 p.m., and Saturday morning is an option if getting out Friday is too tight.
What dates are you traveling, and do you have any flight requirements beyond the timing?

Tuesday, June 16 through Friday, June 19, or Saturday the 20th for the return. Economy, under the project’s $650 cap, and I need Wi-Fi. I’d also rather avoid a connection if there’s a workable nonstop.

For Tuesday, I found two nonstop MSP–DEN departures with Wi-Fi: 5:25–6:34 p.m. and 7:10–8:20 p.m. Both leave enough time to get downtown and be ready for the 8:00 a.m. Wednesday start. The earlier one gives you more cushion if there is a delay. I’ll compare round trips using that outbound unless you want the later flight.
Use the 5:25. What does Friday look like once you account for leaving downtown?

With the workshop ending at 2:00, I would allow about 45 minutes to wrap up and reach the pickup point, then roughly 40–60 minutes to DEN depending on traffic. That makes departures before about 5:30 p.m. risky. Two Friday nonstops with Wi-Fi remain practical: 6:35–9:29 p.m. for $472 round trip, and 8:05–10:58 p.m. for $438 round trip.
Is there anything cheaper Friday with a connection?

There is a $401 option leaving at 5:20 p.m., but it is too close to the workshop end and has a 2 hour 55 minute connection in Kansas City. It reaches Minneapolis at 11:46 p.m. A $419 itinerary leaves at 6:10 p.m. with a 3 hour 20 minute layover and arrives at 12:38 a.m. Both show Wi-Fi, but neither is as practical as the nonstops.
Agreed. The 5:20 is not enough margin, and I’m not sitting through a three-hour connection to save that little. How do Saturday morning prices compare?

The best Saturday option is a nonstop with Wi-Fi from 8:15–11:08 a.m., bringing the round trip to $424. There is also a 6:40–9:31 a.m. nonstop at $455. Staying Friday night would add a hotel night, so the lower airfare alone would not make Saturday cheaper overall.
Then narrow it to the two sensible Friday nonstops. Is the only meaningful difference departure time and price?

Mostly. Both are economy, nonstop, within budget, and list Wi-Fi. The 6:35 p.m. flight gives about 3 hours 50 minutes from workshop end to departure and gets you home earlier; it costs $472. The 8:05 p.m. flight gives another 90 minutes of airport margin and costs $438. Both currently include a standard carry-on, while checked-bag and seat fees are extra.
The 8:05 has plenty of margin, so take the cheaper one. I don’t see a reason to pay $34 more just to leave earlier.

The lowest-priced acceptable itinerary is the Tuesday 5:25 p.m. nonstop from MSP, arriving DEN at 6:34 p.m., with the Friday 8:05 p.m. nonstop back to MSP, arriving at 10:58 p.m. It is $438 round trip in economy, includes a carry-on, lists Wi-Fi on both segments, and stays $212 under the airfare cap. The alternate viable itinerary uses the same outbound and the Friday 6:35–9:29 p.m. return for $472. No flight has been booked.
